DJI.note: Document names no e-procurement system; the one-stop shop is to take e-payments for administrative services only.

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports Djibouti's ICT ministry launched design work on 15 December 2025 for an integrated G2B platform meant to simplify business creation, with a digital G2B counter and the existing one-stop shop to be extended to administrative services and e-payments.

DJI.note: Document states nothing on the central bank.
Document states nothing on financial consumer protection.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on rural internet access.
Document is about government to business, not payments to people.
Document gives no account survey figure.
Document states nothing on mobile money or retail payments.
Document states nothing on tax or fee payment; e-payments for the one-stop shop are only planned.
A start-up portal is planned within the G2B platform; no startup law, strategy or fund is stated.
Document states nothing on hubs, incubators or parks.
